The high set is a mid-frequency Latinate/markup subword neighbourhood - ' Im' 0.86, 'Kem' 0.80, 'Em' 0.79, 'Im' 0.79, 'html' 0.76, 'iem' 0.76, 'Wesley' 0.70, 'Ward' 0.65, 'surgery' 0.50, 'modules' 0.27 - so predicted-active means the current token is one of that neighbourhood (117 tokens exceed 0.5; a neutral-frame table recovers them), and predicted-inactive means any other token, including the same word under a different tokenisation ('important' 0.17 vs ' Im'+'portant' 0.86) and ordinary words (church 0.17, Word 0.20, physics 0.10); the mechanism is retrospective, since a layer-0 MLP cannot see later tokens and the Jacobian-lens list is noise (kurtosis 3.3, 0% agreement).
